description.sub_name: 先進自動化系統應用與實務
description.sub_ename: APPLICATION AND PRACTICE OF ADVANCD AUTOMATION SYSTEM
description.describe_ch: 講授智慧製造所牽涉到之自動化系統整合應用與實務，主題包含工業物聯網、感測組件、可程式邏輯控制器及聯網設備所牽涉到的知識及實作技術；課程中並結合業界系統，讓學生學習生產製造自動化、智慧化之實施方式，進而熟悉企業聯網應用實務。課程中也將引導學生進行創意發想與實作，完成小型專題。
description.describe_eh: This course teaches the automation system integration applications and practices required for smart manufacturing, including knowledge and implementation techniques for industrial internet of things (IIoT), sensing components, programmable logic controllers (PLC) and networked devices. Combining practical industrial applications, students can understand the automated and intelligent implementation methods of manufacturing systems, and then learn the connected enterprise applications. Students will also be guided by creative thinking and grouping to complete small projects.
